multi_entity_note: XIMAGE and SAGEM S.A. (MORPHO), with the Kuwait Government as end user.
processing_note: MORPHO shall pay all charges under this Agreement,      including the total Annual Maintenance Charge, within thirty (30) days      after receipt of a valid invoice from XIMAGE.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term is stated only as at least one year after the Effective Date, not as a date.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement automatically renews for consecutive one (1) year terms.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Either party must give at least sixty (60) days prior written notice of non-renewal.
